DesignerToolkit.Kb_Bdt_HeightFilterHideL: Decreases the maximum visible height filter layer
DesignerToolkit.Kb_Bdt_HeightFilterShowL: Increases the maximum visible height filter layer
DesignerToolkit.Kb_Bdt_ThroughputAoETool: Activates the throughput area selection tool
DesignerToolkit.Kb_Bdt_TransportCleanup_: Activates the transport cleanup selection tool
DesignerToolkit.Kb_Bdt_TransportLazyHeig: Holds lazy height matching mode while placing transports (Alt)
DesignerToolkit.Kb_Bdt_UndoPlacement__to: Undoes the last BDT placement action
DesignerToolkit.CopyBlueprintMarkdownToo: Copy blueprint stats as a Markdown table to the clipboard, ready to paste into the Hub.
DesignerToolkit.CopyFolderMarkdownToolti: Copy folder blueprint list as a Markdown table to the clipboard.
DesignerToolkit.PlaceAllTooltip: Place all blueprints in this folder.
DesignerToolkit.UpdateBlueprintTooltip: Update the selected blueprint from a new area selection.
DesignerToolkit.GroundwaterSustainableTo: Calculated steady-state monthly replenishment rate post year 10 based on the Weather difficulty setting (Rainwater yield setting affects only Rainwater Harvesters, not groundwater).
DesignerToolkit.HeightRoutingTooltip: Hold or press the shortcut key to toggle lazy height matching. By default belts & pipes match target height as soon as possible. When this is enabled, belts & pipes will stay at their starting height for as long as possible before changing elevation.
DesignerToolkit.LegacyStackerAlertFullTo: Alert when the stack is full.
DesignerToolkit.LegacyStackerUnsupported: The stacker's legs are not sufficiently supported by terrain.
DesignerToolkit.RateLimitSandboxOnly: Throughput limiting is only available in sandbox mode.
DesignerToolkit.SettingsRestoreDefaultsT: Restore the global mod defaults for all settings.
DesignerToolkit.SettingsSaveAsGlobalTool: Save these settings to config.json. They will be used as the defaults for all new games.
DesignerToolkit.SettingsBlueprintSpacing: Spacing (in tiles) between blueprints placed side-by-side during batch placing [0-12].
DesignerToolkit.SettingsGlobalHotkeyTool: This keybind is registered with the game's controls system and can be configured in the vanilla Settings | Controls menu.
DesignerToolkit.SettingsHeightFilterCont: These keybinds are registered with the game's controls system and can be configured in the vanilla Settings | Controls menu.
DesignerToolkit.SettingsHeightFilterMaxV: Limits the height level of transports, structures, and pillars rendered in the world.
DesignerToolkit.SettingsHeightFilterPill: Shows pillars whenever at least one visible transport or elevated structure is attached.
Controls how pillar visibility is evaluated when filtering height layers.
Evaluates each pillar's height independently against the active layer.
Hides all pillars whenever any height layer is filtered out.
dtk.settings.height_filter_pillar_visibi: Detached evaluates each pillar's height independently against the active layer. Attached shows pillars whenever at least one visible transport or elevated structure is attached.
DesignerToolkit.SettingsHeightFilterPill: Controls pillar visibility based on whether its top layer is at or below the visible height limit.
DesignerToolkit.SettingsHeightFilterTran: Controls how transport visibility is evaluated when filtering height layers.
At least one inflection point of the transport must be at or below the threshold layer.
All inflection points of the transport must be at or below the threshold layer.
A majority of the inflection points of the transport must be at or below the threshold layer.
Controls the threshold requirement for transport inflection points against the visible layer.
DesignerToolkit.SettingsInstantBuildMode: Automatically and instantly completes construction, deconstruction, upgrades, and downgrades without materials, workers, or unity (even while paused). Enabling this also turns off the game's insta-build toggle.
Sod off to the sandbox, you lazy git!
DesignerToolkit.SettingsLayoutBoxModeDes: Enables an X-Ray overlay rendering voxel bounding boxes around buildings to show their layout and clearance.
DesignerToolkit.SettingsLegacyBeltConfig: Enables Update 1 style transport construction, allowing transports to turn and incline/decline on the same tile (making curvy incline belts possible to construct directly).
DesignerToolkit.SettingsMarkdownNumberFo: Controls decimal and thousands separators in Markdown exports. Auto follows the rendered table language: English tables use en-US separators and local tables use the current game locale.
DesignerToolkit.SettingsMarkdownTableLan: Controls which language Markdown table headers and product/entity names should use.
English, Local, Both, and Hybrid are wired into Markdown export.
DesignerToolkit.SettingsPollutionDaysToA: Configures the sliding window in game days [0-360] to average emissions. Setting this to 0 completely disables data collection and patches.
DesignerToolkit.SettingsPollutionGlowDes: Cast a glowing light onto polluting entities matching their emission intensity. Disable if causing lag.
DesignerToolkit.SettingsPollutionShowAir: Enables/disables the in-world pollution rate overlay for gaseous air emissions (smokestacks/flares).
DesignerToolkit.SettingsPollutionShowGro: Enables/disables the in-world pollution rate overlay for liquid water discharges (wastewater outfalls).
DesignerToolkit.SettingsPollutionShowShi: Enables/disables the in-world pollution rate overlay for ships. Displays the predicted pollution rate based on the current cargo route's round-trip time and fuel consumption. These values include the effects of game difficulty settings and researched pollution-reduction technologies.
DesignerToolkit.SettingsPollutionShowSol: Enables/disables the in-world pollution overlay for solid waste dumping on terrain (active landfill). Overlay labels are formatted as [Pollution(Tiles)].
DesignerToolkit.SettingsPollutionShowVeh: Enables/disables the in-world pollution rate overlay for vehicles and locomotives.
DesignerToolkit.SettingsPollutionToggleD: Enables/disables the in-world pollution rate overlay. Displays averages over the configured days. These values include the effects of game difficulty settings and researched pollution-reduction technologies.
DesignerToolkit.SettingsPreColorPipesDes: Colors empty pipes from their connected upstream sources. Multiple fluids are blended equally. Actual transport flow takes over the color while they contain products.
DesignerToolkit.SettingsRadiationDaysToA: Configures the sliding window in game days [0-360] to average sampled unsafe radioactive inventory. Setting this to 0 disables data collection.
DesignerToolkit.SettingsRadiationGlowDes: Highlights and adds a glow to entities according to their sampled unsafe radioactive inventory. Disable if causing lag.
DesignerToolkit.SettingsRadiationToggleD: Shows the average amount of unsafe radioactive product held by each entity at the daily sample points used by the overlay.
DesignerToolkit.SettingsRecycleBinFolder: The folder name under the blueprint book root to use as the Recycle Bin.
Invalid folder name. Must not be empty and under 60 characters.
DesignerToolkit.SettingsStoreNotInitiali: Save failed: settings store is not initialized.
DesignerToolkit.SettingsThroughputColorb: Changes the heat-map gradients from Green-Orange-Red to Blue-Yellow-Red for better visibility.
DesignerToolkit.SettingsThroughputGlowDe: Cast a glowing light onto the ground matching the heatmap color. Operates independently of the text overlay. Disable if causing lag.
DesignerToolkit.SettingsThroughputShowAs: Switches the in-world throughput display format from absolute numbers (items/min) to a percentage of the entity's maximum capacity.
DesignerToolkit.SettingsThroughputToggle: Enables/disables the in-world throughput overlays. Individual entities' toggle must still be switched on in inspector or by the throughput tool.
DesignerToolkit.SettingsUseRecycleBinDes: When enabled, blueprints and folders are copied to the recycle bin before deletion or updates, and the delete confirmation popup is suppressed.
DesignerToolkit.ThroughputAoEToolTooltip: Click and drag to select an area, then configure throughput display settings for all selected entities by type.
DesignerToolkit.TransportProductRemovalA: Not enough Unity to quick remove the selected products.
No current remove orders to cancel.
Immediately removes all products from the selected entities for the shown Unity cost.
Sends remove orders for all products in the selected entities.
DesignerToolkit.UndoNoActionMessage: Undo: No placement actions to revert.
